sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Zhalia Moon used Venomhand in the Castle of Vlad Dracul, almost killing Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill before she came to her senses. Klaus later used the spell against Dante Vale, overpowering his Dragonfist spell. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

Zhalia tried to use the spell against Chemosh but he knocked her to the ground before she could use it. [To Be Together]

Zhalia used the spell to attack Araknos during the Huntik team's final battle against the Professor. It proved ineffective however as Araknos was still able to fire his spider silk. [The Mission]

Wilder threatened to use Venomhand against a weakened Sophie to finish her off, until Lok stopped him with the Willblade. [Knight of the Willblade]

Zhalia used the spell as "weedkiller" to free herself from Wildwood Druid's roots. [Chasing Void]

Stack tried to hit Shauna with Venomhand in Klaus' bookshop, but she easily dodged it. [The Blood Spiral]

Zhalia used the spell to attack Tantras on the Erasmus Bridge. [Den vs Harrison]

Tantras used Venomhand to murder Stack in the Blood Spiral Base, teaching his students what the Blood Spiral does to spies. [Boys Will Be Seekers] 

In the Great Rift Valley, Tantras tried to do the same to Zhalia after discovering her true identity, but he was stopped by her powerbonding with Gareon and the pair subsequently erasing his memory. [Sophie on Trial]

On the island of the Phoenix, a Casterwill Hunter attempted to use the spell on Montehue after jumping him from behind, but he grabbed her arm and fell backwards onto her, crushing her. [S2E44] In the Phoenix Volcano, Shauna used Doublespell combined with Venomhand while running to attack Lok, but she was interrupted by Sophie. She later used the spell to try and finish off a captive Sophie, who dodged it. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

In the Professor's castle, Wilder attempted to finish off Den Fears with the spell but was interrupted by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

full_text:
Venomhand is an offensive spell. It creates a green aura of venom around the user's hand. This spell is often used by Zhalia Moon and high-ranking members of the Organization. It is deadly and is often used to eliminate people for good.

== History ==
Zhalia Moon used Venomhand in the Castle of Vlad Dracul, almost killing Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill before she came to her senses. Klaus later used the spell against Dante Vale, overpowering his Dragonfist spell. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

In the Great Rift Valley, Tantras tried to do the same to Zhalia after discovering her true identity, but he was stopped by her powerbonding with Gareon and the pair subsequently erasing his memory. [Sophie on Trial]

On the island of the Phoenix, a Casterwill Hunter attempted to use the spell on Montehue after jumping him from behind, but he grabbed her arm and fell backwards onto her, crushing her. [S2E44] In the Phoenix Volcano, Shauna used Doublespell combined with Venomhand while running to attack Lok, but she was interrupted by Sophie.
